shows: A refusal: the ball nose chart covers softwood, hardwood and MDF only.

options:
Up-cut spiral
Pulls chips up and out. Clears chips best, but it can fray the top face.

Down-cut spiral
Presses chips down. Leaves a clean top face, but clears chips poorly.

Compression
Up-cut tip, down-cut body. Cuts a clean top and bottom face on through cuts.

Straight
Simple straight flutes. General purpose, but harder on the faces than a spiral.

Ball nose
Round tip for 3D surfacing and carving. Softwood, hardwood and MDF only.
chosen:
Ball nose
Round tip for 3D surfacing and carving. Softwood, hardwood and MDF only.

fields.label: DEPTH PER PASS
fields.hint: Leave empty to cut the full board thickness. On a ball nose this is the stepdown, and it sets the cutting diameter.

fields.label: WIDTH OF CUT
fields.hint: Leave empty to cut a full slot, one tool diameter wide. On a ball nose this is the stepover. The Finishing profile assumes a 1 mm skim instead.

fields.label: MACHINE
fields.hint: Not a real model. This preset combines an HSD ES929-class 10 kW spindle, the heavy-nesting acceleration tier, and the reference defaults for feed, breakpoint and vacuum.

fields.checkLabel: First cut: run 65% of the chart feed until the cut proves good

fields.label: FLUTE COUNT CONVENTION
fields.hint: The vendor charts give per-tooth values for the total flute count. Some engineers count only the up-cut flutes on up/down spirals. If that is your convention, the served feed runs conservative.

fields.label: CUT DIRECTION
options: Conventional (lower force, modelled for MDF, melamine and plywood only)

fields.label: FLUTE LENGTH
fields.hint: Enter a value to check the pass depth against the flutes. A pass deeper than the flutes draws a red chip.

fields.label: SPINDLE POWER
fields.hint: Filled from the machine preset. Edit it to override.

fields.label: SPINDLE BREAKPOINT
fields.hint: The rpm where constant torque becomes constant power. Typically 12000.

fields.label: MACHINE MAX FEED
fields.hint: Filled from the machine preset. Edit it to override.

fields.label: AXIS ACCELERATION
fields.hint: No OEM publishes this value. Derived tiers: hobby 0.4-1, light 1-3, heavy nesting 2-4.

fields.label: PART FOOTPRINT ON VACUUM
fields.hint: Enter a value to enable the hold-down check, for example 80.

fields.label: SMALLEST FEATURE LENGTH
fields.hint: Enter a value to enable the corner check, for example 120.

fields.label: VACUUM ΔP ACHIEVED
fields.hint: On a cut-open nested sheet, 2.4-7 kPa is realistic. 83 kPa is a sealed pod, not a nest.

fields.label: GRIP FACTOR
fields.hint: Your own estimate, typically 0.4. No source publishes this value. It covers friction, air leakage and safety margin.

fields.label: TIMBER DENSITY
fields.hint: Solid timber only, for example 515 for radiata. The model is valid 287-1080 kg/m³ and warns outside that range.
